P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor on this page; it relies entirely on typography and layout.

P05.rationale: The case study lacks a framed client portrait, instead using only generic text blocks for the company description.

P07.rationale: A single statistic (58%) is present as a data point, but it does not constitute a full social-proof apparatus like a press wall or review grid.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements, specifically the large '58%' and the giant ghost numerals in the background.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualizations are present, including a specific percentage statistic and a clear before/after comparison of recruitment results.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text columns and visual elements.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present in the form of a solid dark blue color field that provides high contrast for the white text.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability issues.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup is shown; the layout consists of text and abstract graphical elements.

N07.rationale: The imagery appears generic/stock rather than specific to a real business, as there are no photos of actual people or branded environments.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is dense and fills most of the page with content.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim because there are no photos overlaid with text in this design.
